# EXCALIBUR Control Center v0.5.3

Packaging/release hardening patch. A native Linux **read-only hardware telemetry
control center** for CASPER EXCALIBUR G870 laptops, delivered as a single Arch
Linux package (`excalibur-control-center`) that contains the Qt6 GUI **and** the
`excalibur-wmi` read-only hwmon driver (integrated DKMS).

This release fixes prebuilt-package compatibility and the release checksum
pipeline. It adds **no** new capabilities. The product still only reports
telemetry — it does not control any hardware.

## Fixed

- **Prebuilt package can no longer install on an incompatible Qt.** A binary linked
  against Qt 6.N needs that Qt symbol version at runtime. The release package now
  declares the exact minimum Qt it was built against (`qt6-base>=6.N`, derived from
  the build environment and checked against the binary), so **pacman refuses to
  install it on an older Qt** instead of installing an app that cannot start.
  Source/AUR builds remain unconstrained and compile against the system Qt.
- **Release source checksum is no longer self-referential.** The PKGBUILD records
  the SHA-256 of the release source archive; that archive no longer contains the
  packaging recipe (`packaging/` and `.github/` are excluded via
  `.gitattributes`), so the checksum is stable and verifiable. CI checks the
  PKGBUILD checksum against the published tag archive.

## Changed

- Removed the deprecated `CLEAN` directive from `driver/dkms.conf` (DKMS >= 3
  ignores it and emitted a deprecation warning).

## Not supported

There is no fan control, no RGB control, no power control, no performance mode,
and no EC/WMI writes. The application never requires root.

## Known limitations

- **Kernel API compatibility:** the driver is verified against the **7.2.x** kernel
  API. It does **not** build against **6.18.x-lts** because
  `wmidev_set_block` / `wmidev_query_block` are absent there.
- **Telemetry fidelity:** the GUI shows raw hwmon values; anomalous firmware/EC
  samples are not hidden.
- **Secure Boot:** the package neither generates keys nor signs modules; the user
  handles module signing.
- **AUR:** publication is pending registration availability.

## Install (Arch Linux / CachyOS)

The AUR package is not published yet. Until it is available:

- build the package from source (see the repository README), or
- install the release package artifact directly:

  ```bash
  sudo pacman -U excalibur-control-center-0.5.3-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
  ```

The GUI runs without root (unprivileged runtime). Package installation and the DKMS
kernel-module lifecycle may require root. The prebuilt package requires a Qt at
least as new as the one it was built against (see `SHA256SUMS` / package metadata).
